import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        int n1 = n / 2;
        List<Integer> a1List = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> a2List = new ArrayList<>();

        // Generate all subset sums for first half
        sums1(a, 0, 0, n1, m, a1List);
        // Generate all subset sums for second half
        sums2(a, n1, 0, n, m, a2List);

        // Convert lists to sets to remove duplicates and sort
        TreeSet<Integer> a1Set = new TreeSet<>(new HashSet<>(a1List));
        List<Integer> sortedA1 = new ArrayList<>(a1Set);

        int ans = 0;
        for (int val : a2List) {
            int target = m - val;
            int j = Collections.binarySearch(sortedA1, target);
            if (j < 0) {
                j = -j - 1;
            }
            if (j > 0) {
                int candidate = sortedA1.get(j - 1) + val;
                if (candidate > ans) {
                    ans = candidate;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    private static void sums1(int[] a, int index, int sum, int limit, int mod, List<Integer> result) {
        if (index == limit) {
            result.add(sum);
        } else {
            sums1(a, index + 1, (sum + a[index]) % mod, limit, mod, result);
            sums1(a, index + 1, sum, limit, mod, result);
        }
    }

    private static void sums2(int[] a, int index, int sum, int n, int mod, List<Integer> result) {
        if (index == n) {
            result.add(sum);
        } else {
            sums2(a, index + 1, (sum + a[index]) % mod, n, mod, result);
            sums2(a, index + 1, sum, n, mod, result);
        }
    }
}
